newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ascend estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ascend estimates raised.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Joe Noel raised his estimates for Ascend Communications after the company beat his third quarter earnings projections.
-- He boosted his 1996 earnings estimate to $1.01 a share on revenues of $542.6 million from a previous $0.94 a share on revenue of $513.3 million.
-- Noel lifted his 1997 estimate to $1.50 a share on revenues of $921.9 million from $1.41 a share on revenues of $859 million.
-- He maintains a buy rating on the stock.
